SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT

This Sponsorship Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of January 26, 2026 between Harrowgate Athletic Foundation, an Illinois nonprofit corporation ("Property"), and Larkspur Financial Group, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Sponsor").

RECITALS

A. Property organizes and operates the Harrowgate Marathon, an annual road race held in Chicago, Illinois (the "Event").

B. Sponsor wishes to become the title sponsor of the Event for the term stated below.

1. SPONSORSHIP RIGHTS

1.1 Designation. Property grants Sponsor the exclusive right to be designated the title sponsor of the Event, and the Event shall be named the "Larkspur Harrowgate Marathon" in all Property-controlled materials.

1.2 Category Exclusivity. Property shall not grant any sponsorship, advertising, or promotional right in connection with the Event to any other provider of retail banking, consumer lending, wealth management, or insurance products during the Term. This exclusivity does not restrict Property from accepting sponsors in unrelated categories.

1.3 Benefits. Property shall provide the benefits listed on Exhibit A, including the start-line arch, finish-line branding, sixty (60) seconds of public-address mentions per hour, a logo on all participant bibs and finisher shirts, a hospitality area for one hundred (100) guests, thirty (30) complimentary entries, and inclusion in all Event advertising in which any sponsor is named.

1.4 Digital. Property shall include Sponsor's logo on the Event website home page and registration flow, shall publish six (6) Sponsor-approved social posts per year, and shall provide Sponsor with aggregate, de-identified registration analytics. Property shall not share any participant's personal information with Sponsor without that participant's opt-in consent.

2. SPONSOR OBLIGATIONS

2.1 Fee. Sponsor shall pay Property $850,000 per Event year, payable $425,000 on January 31 and $425,000 on June 30 of each year of the Term.

2.2 Activation. Sponsor shall spend at least $200,000 per Event year on activation, and shall submit its activation plan to Property for approval at least ninety (90) days before each Event.

2.3 Use of Marks. Sponsor may use the Event marks listed on Exhibit B solely to promote its sponsorship, in the form Property specifies. All goodwill from that use inures to Property.

3. APPROVALS AND BRAND SAFETY

3.1 Approvals. Each party shall approve the other's use of its marks in advance, and shall not unreasonably withhold or delay approval. A submission not rejected within five (5) business days is deemed approved.

3.2 Reputational Protection. Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately if the other, or an individual closely identified with the other, engages in conduct that is criminal or that is reasonably likely to bring the terminating party into public disrepute, after giving the other party notice and a reasonable opportunity to respond.

4. EVENT DELIVERY

4.1 Staging the Event. Property shall stage the Event on the date stated on Exhibit A, on a certified course, with the permits, insurance, medical support, and security an event of its size requires.

4.2 Change of Date, Venue, or Format. Property shall notify Sponsor promptly of any change to the date, venue, or format. If the Event is held on a materially different date or in a materially different format, Sponsor may terminate this Agreement for the affected Event year and receive a pro rata refund of the fee for that year.

4.3 Cancellation and Force Majeure. If the Event is cancelled for a reason beyond Property's reasonable control, Property shall, at Sponsor's election, refund the fee for that Event year, credit it against the next Event year, or provide substitute benefits of comparable value. If the Event is cancelled for any other reason, Property shall refund the fee for that year in full within thirty (30) days.

4.4 Attendance Shortfall. If registered participants number fewer than 18,000 in any Event year, Property shall credit Sponsor five percent (5%) of that year's fee for each full 1,000 participants below that number, up to twenty-five percent (25%) of the fee.

5. TERM AND RENEWAL

5.1 Term. This Agreement covers the 2026, 2027, and 2028 Events (the "Term").

5.2 Right of First Negotiation. Property shall notify Sponsor at least one hundred eighty (180) days before the end of the Term and shall negotiate exclusively with Sponsor for sixty (60) days regarding a renewal. If the parties do not agree, Property may negotiate with others, but may not offer another sponsor terms materially better than those Sponsor last offered without first offering them to Sponsor.

6. INDEMNITY, INSURANCE, AND LIABILITY

6.1 Property Indemnity. Property shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Sponsor against any claim arising out of the staging of the Event, out of Property's breach of this Agreement, or out of Property's use of Sponsor's marks outside the approved use.

6.2 Sponsor Indemnity. Sponsor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Property against any claim arising out of Sponsor's products or services, out of Sponsor's activation activities, or out of Sponsor's use of the Event marks outside the approved use.

6.3 Procedure. The indemnified party shall give prompt written notice, the indemnifying party shall control the defense with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified party, and no settlement imposing a non-monetary obligation on the indemnified party may be made without its consent.

6.4 Insurance. Property shall maintain commercial general liability insurance including event and participant coverage of at least $10,000,000 per occurrence, naming Sponsor as an additional insured, and shall deliver a certificate before each Event.

6.5 Limitation. Except for the indemnity obligations in this Section 6, breach of Section 1.2, and either party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, neither party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall exceed the fees paid or payable for the Event year in which the claim arose, and neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages.

7. TERMINATION

7.1 For Cause. Either party may terminate on written notice if the other materially breaches and fails to cure within thirty (30) days.

7.2 Effect. On termination, Property shall cease using Sponsor's marks and the Event name, Sponsor shall cease using the Event marks, and Property shall refund the pro rata portion of any fee paid for benefits not delivered. Sections 2.3, 6, 7.2 and 8 survive.

8. GENERAL

8.1 Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois. Any action arising out of this Agreement shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in Cook County, Illinois.

8.2 Assignment. Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other's written consent, except to a successor to substantially all of its business.

8.3 Notices. All notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by electronic mail with confirmation of receipt, to the addresses stated beneath the signatures.

8.4 Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Agreement, with its exhibits, is the entire agreement between the parties and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

HARROWGATE ATHLETIC FOUNDATION
